## Overview

**Customer Churn Prediction** — part of the [Data Science Projects Collection](https://github.com/PaulChanCyber/Data-Science-Project-). Churn classification for retention campaigns (PDS PDF report).

## Background & Motivation

**Churn Prediction — Programming for Data Science** (PDF report in repo root).

Telecom and subscription businesses lose revenue when churn is detected late; early risk scoring targets retention spend.

## Project Guidelines & Objectives

- Define churn label from usage/billing history
- Feature engineering on tenure, charges, contract type
- Train classifiers (logistic regression, trees)
- Optimize precision/recall for retention campaigns
- Present business recommendations in PDF report

## Data Collection & Preparation

Customer usage and billing features with churn label (per course dataset).

## Methodology & Analysis

Classification pipeline; class imbalance handling; ROC and confusion matrix review.

## Model Evaluation

Precision/recall on high-risk segment; ROI narrative for retention.

## Results & Key Learnings

Formal PDS PDF report on churn modeling and intervention strategy.
